WITH RECURSIVE ancestors AS ( SELECT menu_id,upr_menu_id,use_yn FROM sys.menu WHERE scrn_id=#{screenId} UNION SELECT m.menu_id,m.upr_menu_id,m.use_yn FROM sys.menu m JOIN ancestors p ON m.menu_id=p.upr_menu_id ) SELECT r.role_id AS "roleId",r.data_scope_cd AS scope,r.snstv_inq_yn='Y' AS sensitive, r.part_std_chg_auth_yn='Y' AS "partStandardChange",u.dev_id AS "developerId" FROM sys.user_info u JOIN sys.user_role ur ON ur.user_id=u.user_id JOIN sys.role r ON r.role_id=ur.role_id AND r.use_yn='Y' JOIN sys.role_menu_auth a ON a.role_id=r.role_id JOIN sys.menu m ON m.menu_id=a.menu_id AND m.scrn_id=#{screenId} AND m.use_yn='Y' WHERE u.user_id=#{userId} AND u.user_stts_cd='ACTIVE' AND (u.rsgn_dt IS NULL OR u.rsgn_dt > #{today}) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ancestors WHERE use_yn<>'Y') AND (m.scrn_id NOT IN ('UI-23','UI-24','UI-25','UI-27') OR r.admin_yn='Y') AND (r.role_id<>2 OR #{actionColumn} IN ('inq_auth_yn','dwnld_auth_yn')) AND a.inq_auth_yn='Y' a.reg_auth_yn='Y' a.mdfcn_auth_yn='Y' a.del_auth_yn='Y' a.upld_auth_yn='Y' a.dwnld_auth_yn='Y' a.cnfrm_auth_yn='Y' FALSE
ORDER BY r.role_id
SELECT p.bsn_part_id FROM sys.user_part p JOIN mst.bsn_part b ON b.bsn_part_id=p.bsn_part_id AND b.use_yn='Y' WHERE p.user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY p.bsn_part_id
SELECT p.prj_id FROM sys.user_prj p JOIN prj.prj b ON b.prj_id=p.prj_id AND b.use_yn='Y' WHERE p.user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY p.prj_id

SELECT count(*) FROM sys.user_info u WHERE u.user_stts_cd='ACTIVE' AND u.rsgn_dt IS NULL AND length(btrim(COALESCE(u.email_addr,'')))>0 AND length(u.pswd_hash)>0 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys.user_role ur JOIN sys.role r ON r.role_id=ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id=u.user_id AND r.admin_yn='Y' AND r.use_yn='Y' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT required.screen FROM (VALUES ('UI-23'),('UI-24'),('UI-25')) required(screen) WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys.role_menu_auth a JOIN sys.menu m ON m.menu_id=a.menu_id WHERE a.role_id=r.role_id AND m.scrn_id=required.screen AND m.use_yn='Y' AND a.inq_auth_yn='Y' AND a.mdfcn_auth_yn='Y' AND NOT EXISTS ( WITH RECURSIVE parents AS ( SELECT menu_id,upr_menu_id,use_yn FROM sys.menu WHERE menu_id=m.menu_id UNION SELECT p.menu_id,p.upr_menu_id,p.use_yn FROM sys.menu p JOIN parents c ON p.menu_id=c.upr_menu_id ) SELECT 1 FROM parents WHERE use_yn<>'Y' ) ) ) )
